# Contract: xlsx

Third-party skill from [anthropics/skills](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) (Apache-2.0, Anthropic), skills-bundle snapshot 2026-11-13. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Spreadsheets). The method is upstream. Category: docs. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Create, read, or fix a spreadsheet when the deliverable is the spreadsheet itself.

## Use it for
- "fix this spreadsheet"
- "build an xlsx with these formulas"

## Not for
- a Word document (docx)
- slides (pptx)
- a one-off analysis that does not produce a spreadsheet

## Accepted inputs
A spreadsheet to read or edit, or tabular data to write.

## Deliverables
An .xlsx (or the other tabular file the skill was asked for).

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local files. Formula recalculation uses the skill's script and a local spreadsheet program if one is installed.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.
